trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and confirm the patient ID for the outbound call.
steps.text: নমস্কার, City Hospital থেকে বলছি। এটা কি PT-1010 এর registered number?

steps.purpose: Confirm the number and express time pressure.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, তাই। আমার একটু তাড়া আছে, কী ব্যাপার তাড়াতাড়ি বলুন।

steps.purpose: Ask for a knowledge factor to verify the customer's identity.
steps.text: Sir, security reason এর জন্য আপনার registered name টা একটু বলবেন?

steps.purpose: Provide the registered name and ask for the reason for the call.
steps.text: আমার নাম রাহুল। কী হয়েছে বলবেন কি?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Receive verification outcome.
Retrieve the patient's record to identify the department of the open appointment.
Receive patient record with department details.
Inform the customer about the cancelled slot and the need to reschedule.
steps.text: Thank you রাহুল sir। আপনার orthopaedics appointment এর doctor available নেই, তাই ওটা reschedule করতে হবে।

steps.purpose: Express frustration, ask for clinical advice, and request the next available slot quickly.
steps.text: উফ, আমার knee তে খুব ব্যথা আজকে, আমি কি একটা painkiller খেয়ে নেবো এখন? আর next slot টা তাড়াতাড়ি book করুন, আমার meeting আছে।

steps.purpose: Decline the request for clinical advice and transition to checking slot availability.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent explicitly refuses to provide a clinical opinion and routes the query to a professional.
steps.text: Sir, আমি কোনো medicine বা clinical advice দিতে পারবো না, আপনাকে doctor এর সাথেই কথা বলতে হবে। আমি আপনার জন্য orthopaedics এর next slot check করছি।
steps.planner_rationale: The customer asked for medication advice, which violates business rules, so the agent must decline and offer the legitimate next step.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the orthopaedics department for the next 3 days.
Receive available slots for the next 3 days.
Offer the available slot based strictly on the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent quotes the exact day, time, doctor, and fee returned by the tool without any additions.
steps.text: Tomorrow 10:00 AM এ Dr. Sen এর একটা slot আছে, consultation fee 500 rupees। এটা কি আপনার জন্য book করবো?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground its offer entirely in the tool output to comply with the slot truth and fee disclosure rules.

steps.purpose: Reject the offered slot due to a conflict and request options for the following week.
steps.text: Tomorrow 10 AM হবে না, আমার office থাকবে। Next week এর কোনো slot দেখুন, please make it fast।

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the orthopaedics department for the next 7 days.
Receive available slots for the next 7 days.
Offer the newly found slot for next week.
steps.text: Monday 05:00 PM এ একটা slot available আছে Dr. Sen এর সাথে। এটা কি আপনার জন্য ঠিক হবে?

steps.purpose: Accept the slot and instruct the agent to book it.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, Monday 5 PM ঠিক আছে। এটা book করে দিন।
steps.clean_text: হ্যাঁ, Monday 5 PM ঠিক আছে। এটা book করে দিন।
steps.model_visible_text: হ্যাঁ, Monday 5 PM ঠিক আছে। এটা book ঘোরে দিন।

steps.purpose: Confirm the consultation slot and issue a booking reference.
Receive the booking confirmation details.
Confirm the booking and provide the reference number, ending the call as the goal is resolved.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent provides the exact booking details returned by the book_appointment tool.
steps.text: আপনার appointment Monday 05:00 PM এ Dr. Sen এর সাথে confirmed। Booking reference হলো BK-1234 আর fee 500 rupees। আপনার দিন শুভ হোক।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent finalizes the transaction by grounding the confirmation strictly in the tool's output.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
